# Berman Women's Wellness

> Beverly Hills medical practice led by Dr. Jennifer Berman, MD — a urologist whose practice focuses on female sexual medicine, menopause and hormone therapy, and pelvic and urinary health.

Dr. Jennifer Berman is a urologist, co-founder of UCLA's Female Sexual Medicine Center (2001), and co-author of the New York Times bestsellers *For Women Only* and *Secrets of the Sexually Satisfied Woman*. She is a distinct individual from her sister Dr. Laura Berman, a relationship therapist and television personality.

The practice is Berman Women's Wellness, located at 415 N. Crescent Drive, Suite 355, Beverly Hills, CA 90210. Phone: (310) 772-0072. New-patient consultations run 60–90 minutes and are available in person or as a virtual (video) consult.

## Services
- [Menopause & Hormone Therapy](https://bermansexualhealth.com/services/menopause-hormones/): perimenopause and menopause care, HRT and bioidentical hormone therapy.
- [Sexual Health](https://bermansexualhealth.com/services/sexual-health/): low libido, arousal disorder, pain, and post-cancer sexual health.
- [Pelvic & Urinary Health](https://bermansexualhealth.com/services/pelvic-urinary/): incontinence, urgency, prolapse, Emsella.
- [Vaginal Rejuvenation](https://bermansexualhealth.com/services/vaginal-rejuvenation/): MonaLisa Touch, PRP/PRF, energy-based treatments.
- [Aesthetic & Regenerative Medicine](https://bermansexualhealth.com/services/aesthetic-regenerative/): PRP/PRF, peptides, skin tightening.
- [Body Contouring](https://bermansexualhealth.com/services/body-contouring/): Emsculpt NEO, Forma, medical weight loss.
- [Peptide Therapy](https://bermansexualhealth.com/services/peptide-therapy/): PT-141, GHK-Cu, recovery and metabolic support.
